title: Publish the shared research ledger as a VitePress website
question: Can visitors follow projects, open tasks, results and evidence through a Markdown documentation site generated from the shared Python ledger?
rationale: User requested GitHub Pages via Actions and asked to use the documentation style from Mini, which uses VitePress.
next_action: Use research.py site for local generation; commit research updates to main for automatic publication.
notes: Completed website and actual GitHub Pages deployment; tests, independent reviews and observed browser checks are linked through the implementation RUN. No mathematical result is claimed.
success_criteria: Generate task/project/result/activity/detail Markdown from ledger via Python CLI.
Use VitePress with local search, sidebar, responsive styling and light/dark modes matching Mini.
Keep task completion, run outcomes and mathematical proof status distinct; link source reports/evidence.
Test generator and site build; deploy through GitHub Actions on main and verify live URL.
resource_limit: Bounded website implementation and review only; no mathematical research.
